verdict.rationale: Fellow documents the pieces an agent needs: a REST endpoint to list action items with filters and pagination, including assignee scopes and an updated_at window for incremental sync. It also offers registrable webhooks that POST when an AI note is generated, and an MCP server that exposes action items to AI assistants. That supports an agent pulling each meeting's action items and pushing them to a tracker, but nothing in the evidence shows a native automation into Linear, Jira or Asana, so the filing step must be built by the user or agent. missing for 10: native Linear/Jira/Asana integration or automation, a documented 'action item created' webhook event and payload schema, a documented end-to-end tracker-sync example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
